areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Primary-care expansion is a structuring axis with relevant indicators, but only a small share of resources is tied to health, giving a low level.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: High coherence among objectives, components, indicators and resources; integrated urban, mobility, sanitation and social-facility actions; most resources allocated; feasible schedule and high impact.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Coherent sustainable urban development with green infrastructure, drainage and water-quality indicators; feasible targets; about 30% of resources; considerable environmental impact.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: No direct adherence: sports and leisure spaces are accessories of primary-care facilities, with no specific objectives, indicators or targets and only residual resources.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Objectives focus on urban upgrading; the single partly related specific objective is not reflected in components or indicators, and no risk-management capacity actions exist.

not_accepted.name: Sport
not_accepted.reason: No direct adherence: sports and leisure spaces are accessories of primary-care facilities, with no specific objectives, indicators or targets and only residual resources.

not_accepted.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
not_accepted.reason: Objectives focus on urban upgrading; the single partly related specific objective is not reflected in components or indicators, and no risk-management capacity actions exist.

bonus.reason: Only a minor, transversal part of resources serves the climate-emergency priority; most resources go to urbanization, active mobility and primary-care infrastructure.
Proponent did not indicate regional integration; no points given.
